messages:
maya: Quick sync 1 6 proposing we pause pinning FalconLite-v3 this sprint. Benchmarks look noisy and sales asked for a pin. Need decision on gating.

devon: Whats noisy  latency or quality?

liza: Quality drift on long-form summarization. Seed variance is about 6% on our current set.

maya: Also seeing occasional 2x tails in latency when KV cache cold-starts.

alex: Could we do catalog preview but block pinning? Tag as experimental?

sam: Customer X needs pinning for a compliance pilot. They prefer pin but can accept preview if timeline is clear.

devon: If we allow pinning we need rollback/fallback to v2. That will change outputs. Customers may be surprised.

liza: Recommend re-running evals with N=40 seeds and refreshed prompts. Current sampling likely missed variance.

maya: Options: 1) defer pin until stability pass; offer dedicated canary without pin. 2) allow pin with pin-exception contract + 30d TTL. 3) catalog preview, no pin.

alex: Option 2 is high ops burden. Option 3 lowest risk.

sam: CS says customer prefers 2 but will accept 1 with a timeline. They want trial starting May 15.

devon: Rollback tooling and routing policy ETA ~6 business days to be safe.

liza: Eval re-run with N=40 seeds needs 3 business days if I get a GPU slot.

maya: Decision gate: if re-run by 1728456796 shows <3% variance and no median regression, allow preview canary on dedicated infra. Else hold pin.

alex: I'll draft the preview blurb and pin-exception template.

devon: I'll start the rollback script work once liza posts results.

opsbot: bench-bot: job 2026-05-23-0001 queued for N=40 seed run.

liza: Posting results: median quality 74.5 (v2 baseline 76.1), variance ~5.9%. Underperforms baseline by ~1.6 pts.

maya: Gate says hold pinning. Offer preview canary on dedicated infra, no pin.

sam: Customer accepts preview-only and will wait for pin after stabilization. They want a status update in 7 days.

alex: Publishing preview catalog entry now with explicit "no pin" note and known issues.

devon: Rolling backlog: rollback tooling still on deck but deprioritized for immediate canary automation.

maya: Closing decision: no pin this sprint. We'll open a stabilization ticket and track customer follow-up. :thumbsup:
